tasks.description: Review pr-prd-add-a-change-to-d64b61-architecture-agent for Show deploy version status in the manager
acceptance: The manager displays a version number sourced from the version data produced during the deploy phase rather than a hardcoded value.
When the deploy phase creates a version that is newer than the manager's previously known version, the manager shows a clear new-version indication next to or with that version number.
When no newer deploy-created version is available, the manager still displays the current version number without showing the new-version indication.

Automated coverage is added or updated for the manager version display covering both new-version and non-new-version states, and the relevant test or typecheck command passes on the dev-targeted workflow.
